scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run start:dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:contracts: node init && cd stellar-contracts && cargo build
scripts.start: node init && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run start:prod
scripts.start:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run start
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.ci:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.ci:build: npm run build && npm run build:contracts
scripts.security:audit: npm audit && cd backend && npm audit && cd ../frontend && npm audit
